title: Power series in generators of I map onto the I-adic completion
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f_1,\ldots,f_n\in R$ ($n\geq0$), $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_n)$, and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_mR/I^m$ the $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For $F=\sum_Ea_Ex^E\in R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] and $m\geq1$ put $F_{<m}(f)=\sum_{|E|<m}a_Ef^E\in R$ (with $f^E=f_1^{e_1}\cdots f_n^{e_n}$, $|E|=e_1+\cdots+e_n$). Then $\Phi(F)=(F_{<m}(f)\bmod I^m)_{m\geq1}$ is an element of $R^\wedge$, and $\Phi:R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]\to R^\wedge$ is a surjective ring homomorphism with $\Phi(x_i)=(f_i\bmod I^m)_m$ and $\Phi(r)=(r\bmod I^m)_m$ for $r\in R$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), proof, lines 23075-23084: 'Consider the map R[[x_1,...,x_n]] -> R^, x_i -> f_i. This is a well defined and surjective ring map (details omitted)'

proof.text: Evaluation sends the variable ideal into I: each X_i evaluates to f_i in span(range f). Ideal.le_comap_pow and monotonicity of powers imply evaluation sends its m-th power into I^m. Compose Mathlib MvPowerSeries.truncTotalAlgHom with Ideal.quotientMap to obtain the quotient-valued ring homomorphism q_m(F) = F_{<m}(f) mod I^m; multiplicativity is already proved by truncTotalAlgHom.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), proof, lines 23075-23084: 'Consider the map R[[x_1,...,x_n]] -> R^, x_i -> f_i. This is a well defined and surjective ring map (details omitted)'

proof.text: Mathlib truncTotal_sub_truncTotal_mem_pow_idealOfVars shows truncations at b and a differ in the a-th power of the variable ideal when a <= b. Step 1 sends that difference into I^a. Thus factorPow I sends q_b to q_a. AdicCompletion.liftRingHom constructs Phi, and eval_a_liftRingHom gives its projection formula at every level including zero.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), proof, lines 23075-23084: 'Consider the map R[[x_1,...,x_n]] -> R^, x_i -> f_i. This is a well defined and surjective ring map (details omitted)'

proof.text: For xi choose an adic Cauchy sequence r representing it using AdicCompletion.mk_surjective. Its successive differences r(m+1)-r(m) belong to I^m, including m=0. Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous gives homogeneous P_m of degree m evaluating to that difference. Define F coefficientwise by a_d = coeff_d(P_|d|). Homogeneity and finite sum_eq_single show truncTotal m F = sum_{k<m} P_k.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), proof, lines 23075-23084: 'Consider the map R[[x_1,...,x_n]] -> R^, x_i -> f_i. This is a well defined and surjective ring map (details omitted)'

proof.text: Use G = F + C(r(0)). At positive level m its evaluated truncation is sum_{k<m}(r(k+1)-r(k)) + r(0) = r(m), by induction on m and sum_range_succ. At level zero the quotient is trivial. The projection formula, eval_a_mk and ext_eval_a show Phi(G)=xi. This proves surjectivity with no completeness or Noetherian hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0316 (lemma-completion-Noetherian-Noetherian, line 23065), proof, lines 23075-23084: 'Consider the map R[[x_1,...,x_n]] -> R^, x_i -> f_i. This is a well defined and surjective ring map (details omitted)'

proof.text: The coefficients show truncTotal m X_i is X_i for m>1 and zero otherwise. For m<=1, f_i in I is also in I^m by pow_le_pow_right. Thus Phi(X_i)=of(f_i) by ext_eval_a. Likewise truncTotal m C(r) is C(r) at positive levels and level zero has a trivial quotient, giving Phi(C(r))=of(r).

lean.statement: theorem exists_surjective_toAdicCompletion {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → R) (I : Ideal R) (hI : I = Ideal.span (Set.range f)) : ∃ Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R →+* AdicCompletion I R, (∀ (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → AdicCompletion.evalₐ I m (Φ F) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ m) (MvPolynomial.eval f (MvPowerSeries.truncTotal m F))) ∧ Function.Surjective Φ ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, Φ (MvPowerSeries.X i) = AdicCompletion.of I R (f i)) ∧ (∀ r : R, Φ (MvPowerSeries.C r) = AdicCompletion.of I R r)
